cards.name: Thin Green Neon
cards.summary: Neon-tube outline in soft mint green: the interior is left empty and the edge becomes 7 stacked strokes of decreasing width, with saturated outer edges around a paler core of the same hue, giving a fine tube that reads as a crisp double hairline. Pure vector, no blur or glow effect. On the light plate there is no glow and the pale core almost merges with the background; the look is meant for dark backgrounds. (Thumbnail: the style applied by script with applyTo to a 5-point star and outlined 'PGD' letters on a light grey plate; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: fine neon line art or icons on a dark background
outline accents around a neon headline
avoid: light backgrounds: no glow shows and the pale core merges with the background; put it on near-black
a real glow halo: these are strokes only; add Effect > Stylize > Outer Glow or use Yellow Glow
solid shapes or small body text: the interior is empty and the stacked strokes clog small counters
a different line weight: use the Thick or regular version of the same colour
cards.applies_to: any page item with a path outline: path, compound path, group, outlined or live type; works best on bold letterforms and simple closed shapes. A full graphic style made only of stacked strokes (no live effects): it replaces the object's appearance and leaves the interior empty; the style must exist in the target document.
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Graphic Style Libraries > Neon Effects, select an object, click 'Thin Green Neon' (Alt-click adds it to the current appearance instead of replacing it).
